explanation: Evidence only covers the itraconazole/rifampin PK numbers. Claims about CYP3A/SULT2A1 metabolism, palbociclib being a weak CYP3A inhibitor, specific drug lists (clarithromycin, phenytoin, etc.), grapefruit avoidance, and narrow-therapeutic-index substrate dosing are not established by the provided evidence.
suggested_rewrite: Limit claims to the itraconazole and rifampin AUC/Cmax data shown; note that other mechanistic and interaction-list details require verification against the full Prescribing Information.
